verses.en: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
verses.pt: O Senhor reina, tremam os povos; ele está entronizado sobre os querubins, estremeça a terra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is King; let the peoples be in fear: his seat is on the winged ones; let the earth be moved.

verses.en: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
verses.pt: O Senhor é grande em Sião, e exaltado acima de todos os povos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is great in Zion; he is high over all the nations.

verses.en: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
verses.pt: Louvem o teu nome, grande e tremendo; pois é santo.
verses.en_web: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!
verses.en_bbe: Let them give praise to your name, for it is great and to be feared; holy is he.

verses.en: The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.pt: És Rei poderoso que amas a justiça; estabeleces a eqüidade, executas juízo e justiça em Jacó.
verses.en_web: The King’s strength also loves justice. You do establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: The king's power is used for righteousness; you give true decisions, judging rightly in the land of Jacob.

verses.en: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
verses.pt: Exaltai o Senhor nosso Deus, e prostrai-vos diante do escabelo de seus pés; porque ele é santo.
verses.en_web: Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
verses.en_bbe: Give high honour to the Lord our God, worshipping at his feet; holy is he.

verses.en: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
verses.pt: Moisés e Arão entre os seus sacerdotes, e Samuel entre os que invocavam o seu nome, clamavam ao Senhor, e ele os ouvia.
verses.en_web: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel among those who call on his name; they called on Yahweh, and he answered them.
verses.en_bbe: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among those who gave honour to his name; they made prayers to the Lord, and he gave answers to them.

verses.en: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
verses.pt: Na coluna de nuvem lhes falava; eles guardavam os seus testemunhos, e os estatutos que lhes dera.
verses.en_web: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.
verses.en_bbe: His voice came to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his witness, and the law which he gave them.

verses.en: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
verses.pt: Tu os ouviste, Senhor nosso Deus; tu foste para eles um Deus perdoador, embora vingador dos seus atos.
verses.en_web: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
verses.en_bbe: You gave them an answer, O Lord our God; you took away their sin, though you gave them punishment for their wrongdoing.

verses.en: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.
verses.pt: Exaltai o Senhor nosso Deus e adorai-o no seu santo monte, porque o Senhor nosso Deus é santo.
verses.en_web: Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!
verses.en_bbe: Give high honour to the Lord our God, worshipping with your faces turned to his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.
